Name: Diverse Stardew Valley Expanded
Author: AirynS
Description:
[size=5][b]This mod is no longer supported. It is being reposted for visibility, but will not receive updates and may or may not have minor visual inconsistencies.[/b][/size]

Inspired by [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/modpacks/8013]Diverse Stardew Valley[/url], this mod edits the skintones, hair, and facial features of many of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] characters for greater racial diversity. It also automatically supports Poltergeister’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5975?]Seasonal Outfits for SVE (Vanilla Style)[/url], which adds seasonal & festival outfits.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]:

[list=1]
[*]Extract the "[CP] Diverse SVE" and "[STF] Stardew Valley Expanded" folders.

[*]Copy the "[CP] Diverse SVE" folder into your Mods folder. The config file has all characters set to ‘true’ by default - change the value to ‘false’ for any characters you don’t want to use. Seasonal outfits will be automatically applied if you have Seasonal Outfits for SVE in your Mods folder.
[*]If you are using Isaac, Alesia, or Claire, copy the “[STF] Stardew Valley Expanded” folder for each character you’re using and allow it to override the default “[STF] Stardew Valley Expanded” folder. This will ensure that vendor portraits are accurate.
[/list]
The original designs of some SVE characters are already intended to be people of colour; these designs are not intended to erase that perception of the original design, only to simply offer an alternative.
